forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO (ambiguity rule): Switzerland session convened June 21, after June 16 deadline. June 15 preliminary ceasefire agreement reached via back-channels did not constitute a named convened session per criterion. Per ambiguity rule, back-channel-only contact without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Sources: Al Jazeera, CNBC, Swiss EDA MOU 2026-06-17.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that 'talks continue' or relay of written messages does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/CNN/Al Jazeera) OR one TIER1 + official Israeli (IDF) or Iranian (IRGC) statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Proxy-only attacks (Hezbollah/Houthi) without direct Iran-Israel state strikes do NOT count; one-directional strikes within the 48h window = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES (ambiguity rule YES provision): Shas and UTJ formally withdrew ministerial support over military conscription crisis, reducing the coalition to 48-50 seats — below the 61-seat majority threshold. The 62-0 dissolution vote required cross-aisle opposition support to reach the 61-vote minimum for dissolution, constituting a Knesset roll-call confirming the coalition could not muster 61 seats independently. Netanyahu remains caretaker PM through the October 27 election. The ambiguity rule explicitly states: 'If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES.' All three elements are satisfied. Note: DA's strict-criteria argument rested on a narrow reading of the principal resolution_criteria branch and did not engage the ambiguity rule's explicit YES provision — Judge rejects that reading.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

indicators.name: Smotrich formally departs coalition

forecasts.graveyard_reason: Shas + UTJ withdrew ministerial support → coalition at 48-50 seats; 62-0 dissolution vote required opposition cross-support confirming coalition < 61; Netanyahu remains caretaker PM. Ambiguity rule YES provision satisfied.

forecasts.question: Will Hamas publicly issue a formal acceptance, rejection, or conditional counter-proposal in response to Trump's 15-point Gaza road map before EOD 2026-08-31?
forecasts.delta_reason: Kushner met Hamas leadership Cairo Aug 16. Netanyahu rejected the plan, drawing Gulf condemnation. Hamas has structural incentive to engage conditionally to deepen Netanyahu's isolation from Washington and Riyadh. Full acceptance untenable; conditional counter-proposal is most probable modality. A formal Hamas public response before EOD 2026-08-31 is the primary measurable on this track.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Hamas issues before EOD 2026-08-31: (a) formal public acceptance, (b) formal public rejection with named specific objections, or (c) publicly announced counter-proposal in response to the 15-point plan. Silence or unnamed-official statements do NOT count. Must be from named Hamas political bureau leadership or Hamas official media.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera plus Hamas official channel (Al-Aqsa TV, Hamas.ps, or named Hamas political bureau statement carried by TIER1).

forecasts.question: Will commercial vessel transits through the Strait of Hormuz reach a 7-day average of 30 or more per day before EOD 2026-10-01?
forecasts.delta_reason: UKMTO week-of-Aug-17 transit rate at 17% of pre-conflict average (~12/day vs 73/day pre-conflict baseline). IMF PortWatch recorded 1 transit Aug 9. Bloomberg Aug 15: Iran-Oman framework 'close' but two blocking issues remain — Iran's transit fee demand (~5% cargo value, US-rejected) and Iran's demand that US end naval blockade as precondition. Trump Aug 15 'Hormuz US territory' statement further complicates Oman talks. Getting to 30/day requires Iran-Oman signing + partial US blockade lift + P&I insurer return — sequential dependencies not resolvable by Oct 1 at current pace.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if IMF PortWatch (or equivalent AIS: Windward, TankerMap, Lloyd's List Intelligence) records 7-day trailing average >=30 commercial vessel transits/day through Hormuz chokepoint at any point before EOD 2026-10-01.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IMF PortWatch primary; Windward or TankerMap corroboration. One TIER1 shipping/financial source (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List) must confirm AIS reading.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escorts and warships do NOT count toward commercial threshold. Military-escorted commercial convoys DO count if vessels are commercial. If PortWatch unavailable, require two consistent AIS sources; if they conflict >20%, resolve AMBIGUOUS. AIS-jamming or spoofing events that affect data integrity: if two independent AIS providers disagree by >20% on 7-day trailing average, resolve AMBIGUOUS pending reconciliation.

indicators.name: Iran-Oman formal framework signed and fee terms agreed

forecasts.question: Will the US-Iran ceasefire (under the extended Islamabad MOU framework) remain formally in effect — with no declared cessation by either party — through EOD 2026-09-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: Ceasefire extended Aug 12 per Middle East Monitor, PBS, Anadolu Agency, Yeni Safak. Three countervailing pressure vectors: (1) Iran Artesh spokesperson Akraminia stated Iran 'fully exploited' MOU to import equipment and repair systems — an instrumental framing of the ceasefire; (2) Trump Aug 15 'Hormuz US territory' rhetoric without imminent strike indicators; (3) structural gap on enrichment and maritime sovereignty unresolved. Original MOU ceasefire broke down after ~3 weeks in July. 50/50 reflects genuine uncertainty between these vectors.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if on EOD 2026-09-17 neither US nor Iran has publicly declared ceasefire terminated, suspended, or replaced by active military operations. Hormuz incidents not accompanied by official declaration do NOT terminate ceasefire. Israeli operations in Lebanon also do NOT terminate this ceasefire.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: US White House/State Dept statement OR Iranian Supreme Leader/MFA statement declaring ceasefire ended. Absence of such declaration by EOD 2026-09-17 = YES.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Unilateral Trump tweet without formal executive action does NOT resolve YES; must be formal statement from named official with declaratory authority (SecDef, SecState, CENTCOM; or Iranian Supreme Leader/MFA/IRGC chief).
